name: Algorithmic Trading Bots
install:
set -euo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
sudo apt-get update -qq
sudo apt-get install -y -qq python3.12-venv python3-pip ca-certificates
if [ ! -x "$HOME/.trading-venv/bin/python" ]; then
  python3 -m venv "$HOME/.trading-venv"
fi
"$HOME/.trading-venv/bin/python" -m pip install --upgrade pip
"$HOME/.trading-venv/bin/python" -m pip install \
  pandas==2.3.3 \
  numpy==2.5.4 \
  yfinance==1.8.0 \
  ta==0.11.0 \
  matplotlib==3.11.2 \
  seaborn==0.13.2 \
  scikit-learn==1.9.1 \
  jupyterlab==4.6.6 \
  ipykernel==7.4.0
install_wrapper() {
  local name="$1"
  local dest="/usr/local/bin/$name"
  sudo rm -f "$dest"
  printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec %s "$@"\n' "$HOME/.trading-venv/bin/$name" | sudo tee "$dest" >/dev/null
  sudo chmod 755 "$dest"
}
install_wrapper python
install_wrapper python3
install_wrapper pip
install_wrapper pip3
install_wrapper jupyter
install_wrapper jupyter-lab
"$HOME/.trading-venv/bin/python" -m ipykernel install --user --name python3 --display-name "Python 3"
"$HOME/.trading-venv/bin/python" -c "import pandas, numpy, yfinance, ta, matplotlib, seaborn, sklearn, jupyterlab"
echo "install ok"
start:
set -euo pipefail
if (echo >/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8888) >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "JupyterLab already listening on 8888"
  exit 0
fi
exec /home/ubuntu/.trading-venv/bin/jupyter-lab --ip=0.0.0.0 --port=8888 --no-browser --ServerApp.token='' --ServerApp.password='' --ServerApp.allow_remote_access=True --ServerApp.disable_check_xsrf=True
